title: Kőnig's theorems and Dilworth's theorem
summary: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of Kőnig's edge-colouring theorem: the line graph of a finite bipartite graph G is Δ(G)-colourable, and its chromatic number (the chromatic index of G) equals Δ(G). The proof colours edges one at a time with partial proper edge colourings, recolouring by an a/b Kempe-chain swap whose correctness rests on a parity argument in the bipartite graph; the lower bound comes from the edges at a vertex of maximum degree, which are pairwise adjacent in the line graph.
